// Positive control for [NS-33-R11] (BL-1915): Animated.createAnimatedComponent(Image), a real form in the app (see
// src/components/motion/press.ts), and its bare form from a named import. Neither sets the prop.
import { Image } from 'react-native';
import Animated, { createAnimatedComponent } from 'react-native-reanimated';
const FadeImage = Animated.createAnimatedComponent(Image);
const BareFade = createAnimatedComponent(Image);
export function Bad({ uri }: { uri: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <FadeImage source={{ uri }} />
      <BareFade source={{ uri }} />
    </>
  );
}
